summary.en: A carousel book whose chambers are a village street: each house is a box fold cut from the walls across the spine, with a roof, belfry or parapet and doors that open.
summary.es: Un libro carrusel cuyas cámaras son la calle de una aldea: cada casa es un pliegue de caja cortado de las paredes a través del lomo, con techo, espadaña o pretil y puertas que se abren.
summary.fr: Un livre carrousel dont les chambres forment la rue d'un village : chaque maison est un pli en boîte découpé dans les parois en travers du dos, avec toit, clocher-mur ou parapet et des portes qui s'ouvrent.
summary.pt: Um livro carrossel cujas câmaras são a rua de uma aldeia: cada casa é uma dobra em caixa cortada das paredes através da lombada, com telhado, espadana ou platibanda e portas que se abrem.

era: carousel books and cut-and-fold pop-ups, twentieth century to the present
sources: Smithsonian Libraries and Archives, «A Carousel Holiday Decoration», https://library.si.edu/finding-aid/carousel-holiday-decoration
Let's Talk Picture Books, «Favorite Carousel Books», 2022, https://www.letstalkpicturebooks.com/2022/02/favorite-carousel-books.html
Paul Jackson, Cut and Fold Techniques for Pop-Up Designs, Laurence King, 2014
Duncan Birmingham, Pop-Up Design and Paper Mechanics, GMC Publications, 2010
